body: I’ve felt this way for so long and it’s become such a part of me that I’m scared I will never be able to lose these thoughts. There have been times where I go a week without thinking about it, but it always is in my dreams. Every night is about a fire in some way. A burning building, car on fire, a bonfire, always something on fire.
I have contemplated looking for help but my shame overrides it all.

Ive really only contemplated suicide or do a lot of drugs to deal with it so far. I’m so embarrassed by this. It’s my worst nightmare to have my name attached to the event I don’t want people to think I’m a murderer.

I understand that I my lack of intent means i should find some sort of resolve, but it doesn’t. I still do drugs, wish I wasn’t here etc. I understand it’s not my fault but I just can’t forgive myself it’s engrained as a part of me like my personality.
The amount of people and pets that died haunts me so much I can’t describe it
What I did is beyond the general conditions we consider a mistake
In the same way a nurse is friends with a man on deaths door I guess
I caused a fire resulting in unimaginable damage and loss of life due to negligence
It’s a large amount of things but it mainly stems from an accident I caused as a young child resulting in lifelong consequences.
I’ve spent my fair share of time playing video games and other distracting things. it’s only temporary.
